mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) above $550,000 million signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 550000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM decrease > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k MoM and UNRATE decrease
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k MoM and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST is high.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) growth rate below 2% YoY signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% during a late-cycle expansion.
